reader.requirement: At 85 an indexed file's organization is fixed when the file is created (OPEN OUTPUT, or OPEN I-O of an absent optional file); a later OPEN INPUT/I-O/EXTEND through a description of another organization, or an indexed description whose validated fixed attributes differ, must not reinterpret the file: the OPEN is unsuccessful with '39' (§1985:IX.1.3.4), while OPEN OUTPUT creates the file anew.

edition-consulted.switches: the edition the connector was registered with (--std); read only by DialectBehaviors consumers, none of them on the fixed-attribute ('39') comparison
DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility (inactive at 85): sharing arbitration of OPEN, after and apart from the organization check in FileConnector#Open
the LINE SEQUENTIAL gate (2023 only); INDEXED passes at every edition

reader.edition-search: grep DialectBehaviors./Edition in FileConnector.cs, FileRegistry.cs, KeyedConnector.cs, IndexedConnector.cs, KeyedStore.cs, Store/MetaPage.cs, FixedFileAttributes.cs: the path FileConnector#Open (line 1245) -> KeyedConnector#FixedAttributeConflict -> MetaPage#Describes -> FixedFileAttributes#Conflicts consults no edition; FileControlBinder#MapOrganization is edition-agnostic.

reader.notes: The organization is recorded in the keyed store's header and compared on every non-OUTPUT OPEN of an existing file; OPEN OUTPUT establishes it anew. No edition is consulted on this path, and 85's status set has '39', so the shared arm is the 85 answer.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:IX.2.6.3 GR1 (OK  §1985:IX.2.6.3 GR1  (2.6.3 General Rules)  the text is in GR1) and §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR8 (OK  §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR8  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8). Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-007/srt2.cob --std 85: an indexed file written then OPEN INPUT through a SEQUENTIAL description of the same physical file prints SQ-IN-OVER-IX=00 and READ returns store bytes (with the RecordLayoutNotice on stderr); E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-007/srt1.cob: SORT ... USING that sequential description GIVING OU reads 2389 raw 12-byte records of the store, SORT-DONE FS=00; IX-AFTER=00 (the indexed file opens intact afterwards); an indexed description with the prime key at another offset: KEYPOS-DIFF=39. The reader's requirement ('a later OPEN INPUT ... through a description of another organization ... is unsuccessful with 39') overclaims: sequential INPUT over an indexed store is NOT validated (SequentialConnector.cs#FixedAttributeConflict validates only I-O/EXTEND). This does not overturn: GR1 forbids CHANGING the organization, which INPUT never does (the store reopens 00 under its own description), I-O/EXTEND that could change it are 39, OUTPUT recreates, and GR8 makes the validated set implementor-defined; the choice is recorded in docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-129.md arm (4) (owner decision, kb/Work PB802/PB1098).
